name: İyi Finans
verdict: İyi Finans, the savings-finance brand of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş., is wholly owned by its board chair Ali Emre Ballı. Nothing found.
note: Rated none 2026-10-01. Below the back number on Fenerbahçe Tarfin's league shirts in 2026/27 (FenerMedia, 18 September 2026). Brand of Adil Tasarruf Finansman A.Ş.; its 2025 annual-report ownership information shows Ali Emre Ballı holding 100% and chairing the board (Milli Gazete, 17 September 2026; iyi-finans-ownership). A private individual owner, no state in the chain, and no record claim passes the METHOD.md test. Ballı also chairs Tarfin's board (tarfin-ownership), but no stake of his in Tarfin is documented there.
